$comment: Data schema for the Holiday Request solution. Replaces the InfoPath 'Holiday/Annual Leave Request Form' XML data source. Apply with PnP.PowerShell (New-PnPField / Add-PnPField) or the Graph API — this file is the source of truth reviewed in PRs, not something SharePoint reads directly.

lists.listDescription: Each employee's leave entitlement, taken, and remaining days for a given year.

fields.infopathSource: was a free-text name field in InfoPath; upgraded to a real person field

fields.notes: Incremented by the flow when a request against this balance is approved — not user-editable in the app.
InfoPath computed this client-side and never re-validated it; here it's a calculated column so it can't drift.

lists.listDescription: Requests for time off, routed to the employee's manager for approval.

fields.infopathSource: free-text 'manager name' field in InfoPath; upgraded to a real person field
was manually entered and could disagree with the date range; the Power Apps form now computes it from StartDate/EndDate (see powerapps/README.md)

notes: TotalDaysRequested is a plain Number rather than a calculated column because it should count working days only (excluding weekends/holidays), which SharePoint calculated columns can't express — the Power Apps form computes it (see powerapps/README.md) and the flow re-validates it against the balance rather than trusting it blindly.

ApprovalStatus/ApproverComments on Holiday Requests, and TakenDays on Holiday Balances, are written by the Power Automate flow (see ../powerautomate/flows/Submit-HolidayRequest.json), not editable by the requester in the Power Apps form.
